title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Superintegrable systems
exact_target: Find a polynomially superintegrable natural system on the sphere with nonconstant potential and no nontrivial linear or quadratic integral.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100307 (AMR-020-0307). CC BY 4.0.
A. Bolsinov, V. S. Matveev, E. Miranda and S. Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), arXiv:1804.03737, Problem 3.10.
